dialogs.about: 손자가 상을 받아 와서 집에서 축하해요

lines.en: Hi, Grandma! I am home!
Hi! Wow, what is in your hand?
lines.ko: 안녕! 와, 손에 든 게 뭐예요?

lines.en: I won a prize at school this morning.
Congratulations! I am so glad.
Thanks, Grandma. Oops! My bag is open.
Oh no! Did anything fall out?
It's okay. Nothing is broken.
Good. Are you ready for dinner?
Yes! I will wash my hands first.
Okay. I will call Grandpa.

dialogs.about: 길에서 이웃을 만나 좋은 소식을 나눠요

lines.en: Hi! Why do you look so happy?
Hi! My son got a job last week.
Congratulations! I am glad to hear that.
Thanks. He is ready to start soon.
Pardon? Did you say he starts soon?
Yes. Oops, I am speaking too quietly. Sorry.
lines.ko: 네. 이런, 제가 너무 작게 말하고 있네요. 미안해요.

lines.en: It's okay. My hearing is not good.
Are you ready for the garden meeting tomorrow?
Yes. I will bring a pot of tea.
Wow, thank you! See you there. Bye!
lines.ko: 와, 고마워요! 거기서 봐요. 안녕히 가세요.
